Requires ACTIVITYINDICATOR/GRAPHICS_CONTEXT/TIMER and existing adv linkage. See docs/ACTIVITY-INDICATORS.md.

wxDC.scope: Private retained drawing/value adapter via DRAWING-CANVAS/CANVAS-CONTENT and SAVE-CANVAS-IMAGE only. Bounded scene: opaque RGB bytes, signed DIP geometry, Swiss/sans point-size text and copied RGB bitmap buffers; private native DC/font/colour/image/bitmap resources never escape or become Lisp objects. Callback writes/export defer; source/ancestor/native-entry guards and staged scene replacement. Native paint exceptions are contained; PNG output uses private handler and checked non-atomic file write. No standalone class/API parity. See docs/DRAWING-CANVAS.md.

wxGrid.scope: Bounded fixed-shape GRID WINDOW backed by native-owned default string table, dimensions1..256/total16384, cell text and row/column labels, whole-grid editable policy and enabled-editor readback. Native-backed CLOS/defaults/rollback, copied NUL-free programmatic text<=65536UTF8 bytes, zero-based indices. All scalar writers reject Lisp callbacks and active editors; committed reads remain available. Composite Input guards, early Destroy suppression and no managed handler-stack edits. No custom table/editor/renderer, grid events/selection/cursor/shape mutations or full wxGrid parity. Requires wxUSE_GRID/core; docs/GRID.md.

wxWebView.scope: Verified macOS wxWidgets3.2.12 WKWebView backend only. Active GUI thread/session and live WEB-VIEW WINDOW container; private browser child has no public handle. JavaScript enabled for trusted development content, not a security sandbox. Known wx native dialogs/upload/popups/printing suppressed, known permission requests denied; no complete OS WebKit security/permission policy claim. Mutations/scripts reject callbacks and protect receiver/ancestors/native reentry; use deferred actions. No managed handler stacks, native backend adoption, owned/synthetic/cloned web events. See docs/WEB-VIEW.md. Queued immutable command snapshots: :web-message text is JSON (including quoted strings); :web-script-result text is JSON on success or an error description on failure, EVENT-INTEGER is1/0 and EVENT-EXTRA-LONG is the request ticket; :web-loaded text is native URL and :web-error text is native error description. BIND-EVENT supports scoped contexts/Skip/propagation but payload SETF rejects. Async delivery occurs through normal GUI polling/RUN, never directly from an Objective-C completion. Native loaded/error events can reflect prior/subframe navigation; no exact per-navigation correlation or veto API. JavaScript evaluation uses internal WKWebView evaluateJavaScript, not wxWebView::RunScriptAsync/clientData ownership. Native per-navigation veto/history-resource APIs remain unbound. Explicit URL navigation/base-URL inputs support about:blank or absolute http/https/file URLs only; native links, redirects and subresource loads are not a complete navigation sandbox. JSON script messages can originate from all frames and origins; receipt does not authenticate the sender or authorize an action.
